- title: Rate limiter returns 429 too early
rocket-api add a redis cache in front …
the rate limiter is rejecting requests under the limit, find out why
write a regression test for the window rollover
ok ship it and update the changelog
The window key used local time, so the bucket rolled over at the wrong
second near midnight. Fixed in limiter.py with a UTC timestamp and added
